description: Premium annual revenue and seats per client, from portal upgrades (Salesforce Opportunities).
expression: SELECT SUM(Apex_Premium_Upgrade__dlm.Amount__c) AS premium_arr__c, SUM(Apex_Premium_Upgrade__dlm.Seats__c) AS premium_seats__c, COUNT(Apex_Premium_Upgrade__dlm.Opportunity_Id__c) AS upgrades__c, Apex_Premium_Upgrade__dlm.Client_Id__c AS client_id__c FROM Apex_Premium_Upgrade__dlm WHERE Apex_Premium_Upgrade__dlm.Portal_Upgrade__c = true GROUP BY client_id__c
